subject: An editorial still-life of a short stack of paper season-ticket invoices and a single paper ticket stub resting on a weathered green stadium seat armrest, with a few ivy leaves at the edge of the frame.
headline: I paid for the same four
Wrigley seats for 18 years.
After inflation, the price rose
13.0% in the first 11
and 44.9% in the last six.
